[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Soylon''' worked on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] as part of the restoration project by [[Leontyne Saresh]]. He was killed by the [[rakghoul]]s, and his colleague Doctor [[Vernan (scientist)|Vernan]] composed a death notice to send to his wife [[Adali]].
